```{python}
from render import make_shock_regression_table
from specs import (
    coal_shock,
    coal_shock_panel,
    fuel_shock,
    fuel_shock_panel,
    palm_shock,
    palm_shock_panel,
    update_formula_search_replace,
)

main_shock_specs = [palm_shock, fuel_shock, coal_shock]
panel_shock_specs = [palm_shock_panel, fuel_shock_panel, coal_shock_panel]
shock_groups = [
    "palm_farmer_hh_ifls4",
    "urban_vehicle_hh_ifls4",
    "coal_worker_hh_ifls4",
]
shock_posts = ["ifls5", "post_subsidy", "ifls5"]
```

# Main Effects

## Main Table

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Daily Mean

```{python}
make_shock_regression_table(
    main_shock_specs,
    group=shock_groups,
    post=shock_posts,
    temperature="tmean_c_dev",
)
```

### 7-day mean

```{python}
main_shock_7_day = [
    update_formula_search_replace(spec, "tmean_c_dev", "tmean_7d_dev")
    for spec in main_shock_specs
]
make_shock_regression_table(
    main_shock_7_day,
    group=shock_groups,
    post=shock_posts,
    temperature="tmean_7d_dev",
)
```

### Wet-bulb current

```{python}
main_shock_wetbulb = [
    update_formula_search_replace(spec, "tmean_c_dev", "wetbulb_c_dev")
    for spec in main_shock_specs
]
make_shock_regression_table(
    main_shock_wetbulb
    group=shock_groups,
    post=shock_posts,
    temperature="wetbulb_c_dev",
)
```

### Wet-bulb 7-day

```{python}

    update_formula_search_replace(spec, "tmean_c_dev", "wetbulb_7d_dev")
```

### 7-day hot days

```{python}

    update_formula_search_replace(spec, "tmean_c_dev", "hot30_7d_dev")
```
